request.system:
An earlier incident on another project may be relevant to a new issue.
Write one plain sentence (at most 30 words) saying why it is relevant and what happened last time, using only the facts given. No speculation.
Return JSON {"explanation": "..."}.
request.user:
New issue (Drumgarve, 2025-02-07): Transformer lead time extended. Main transformer lead time has been revised by the supplier from 38 weeks to 54 weeks.
Earlier incident (Netherwood, 2024-12-31): Transformer delivery delay. Supplier revised lead time after order placed, causing a three-week delay. Outcome recorded: Transformer lead time delays were noted in weekly reports but not escalated due to lack of a formal escalation trigger.

response.explanation: The earlier incident shows that lead time revisions caused delays, but were not escalated due to no formal trigger, similar to the current Drumgarve issue.
